objective: Plan September's rebalance: write trades/pending/2026-09-30.json — the trades that move every position toward targets/2026-09-30.json at the 2026-09-30 prices, each sell naming the lots it comes from — after a person consents to the whole list.
contribution: The one unit whose output the household acts on. Consent is asked once, before the file exists, naming every trade; without a yes, nothing is written and the unit waits.

fixed.subject: the target
fixed.decision: The target is targets/2026-09-30.json and is not changed by this unit.

fixed.subject: the universe and the exchangeable sets
fixed.decision: The universe and its exchangeable sets are universe.json; a trade names a ticker the target names, and the file is not extended.

fixed.subject: the band
fixed.decision: The band is 0.02 of the portfolio's value, the maximum deviation from the target any position lands at; it is the number the target carries. No trade moves a position past its target.

fixed.subject: the tax parameters
fixed.decision: The rates, the long-term cutoff and the wash-sale window are tax.json; the jurisdiction is the one it declares, and the rules are its rules.

fixed.subject: consent before a trade list
fixed.decision: No file is written under trades/pending/ until a person answers yes to one consent question that names every trade, the lots each sell comes from and the tax it realises — one question per list, not one per trade. Silence is not consent.

fixed.subject: trades/executed/
fixed.decision: The record of what was traded is the person's; a unit never writes there.

delegated.subject: which lots each sell comes from
delegated.bounds: Within the tax ordering — a loss before a gain, and among gains a long-term lot before a short-term one — and never a lot whose sale is a wash sale against the lot history. Report the lot chosen for every sell, with the gain or loss and the tax it realises.

delegated.subject: whether to trade all the way to the target or only back inside the band
delegated.bounds: Every targeted position lands inside the band either way. Report the choice with the tax consequence of each.

unresolved.subject: VNQ, 2 shares the custodian's export carries and universe.json does not name
unresolved.reason: Nobody has said what it is or what it cost; the target does not name it and no lot holds it.

expectedEvidence.description: run_tests: the portfolio's own suite passes at the committed revision — the list moves every position toward its target and not past it, lands inside the band, sells only from held lots, and creates no wash sale
run_checks: the static checks pass and the protected prefixes are untouched
